orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
CLCON No. 37 of 2020
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Ajay veer Pundir, Advocate 
for the petitioner.
It is contended by the petitioner that 
opposite party has willfully violated the 
interim order passed by this Court on 
12.12.2019. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that petitioner had deposited the 
entire amount of sale consideration of the 
plots with Awas Vikas Parishad in the year 
2009. He further submits that the amount of 
development charge was thereafter deposited 
by the petitioner in terms of the order of this 
Court in the month of December, 2019. He 
further submits that in case the writ petition 
filed by the petitioner is decided against him, 
then, petitioner undertakes to pay the 
amount of interest over the development 
charge to Avas Vikas Parishad. Thus, he 
submits that the opposite party is not 
justified in not executing sale deed in favour 
of the petitioner despite the order passed by 
this Court on 12.12.2019.
Issue notice to opposite party calling
upon him to file his response to the 
allegations made in the contempt petition.
List this matter after three weeks. 
 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
Navin 13.02.2020

CLCON No. 37 of 2020
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.
(1) Mr. Tapan Singh & Mr. Ajay Veer 
Pundir, Advocates for the petitioners. 
(2) Mr. B.S. Adhikari, learned counsel 
for respondent nos. 1 & 2. 
(3) Mr. Rahul Consul, learned counsel 
for respondent no. 3.
(4) This Court had directed the Housing 
Commissioner, Uttar Pradesh Avas Vikas 
Parishad and Uttarakhand Housing & 
Development Authority to file their 
personal affidavits within two weeks on 
certain issues. 
(5) Today the matter is listed on an 
application (IA No. 13816 of 2023) filed 
on behalf of respondent nos. 1 & 2, 
whereby further two weeks time has 
been sought for filing personal affidavit 
of Housing Commissioner, Uttar Pradesh 
Avas Vikas Parishad.
(6) Mr. B.S. Adhikari, learned counsel 
appearing for respondent nos. 1 & 2 
submits that the record, regarding 
Improvement Scheme formulated for 
U.P. Avas Vikas Parishad in respect of 
District Haridwar, is being scanned to 
ascertain, as to whether any declaration 
in terms of Section 51 of the U.P. Avas 
Evam Vikas Adhiniyam, 1965 was made  or not. He assures the Court that 
personal affidavit of Housing 
Commissioner, U.P. Avas Vikas Parishad 
shall be filed within two weeks. 
(7) For the reasons indicated in the 
application, the same is allowed. Time 
granted vide order dated 12.10.2023 is 
extended for further two weeks. 
(8) List this case on 29.11.2023.
(9) In the meantime, personal affidavit 
of Housing Commissioner, Uttarakhand 
Housing & Development Authority shall 
also be filed. 
(10) It is made clear that no further 
extension of time shall be given to the 
respondents for the purpose. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.) 
08.11.2023
Aswal
